datasets.name: main_audit_flow_unfiltered
queryLines:
WITH ingestion_flows AS (
  SELECT
    i.dataflow_id AS flow_id,
    'INGESTION' AS flow_type,
    i.dataflow_group_id,
    NULL AS flow_step_id,
    CONCAT(
      i.source_type,
      ' -> ',
      i.target_catalog,
      '.',
      i.target_schema,
      '.',
      i.target_table
    ) AS source_sink_mapping,
    i.target_type,
    i.cdc_load_strategy,
    i.is_active AS flow_is_active,
    dg.environment,
    dg.catalog_name,
    dg.is_active AS group_is_active,
    dg.created_at AS group_created_at,
    dg.updated_at AS group_updated_at
  FROM
    ingestion_flow_spec i
      INNER JOIN dataflow_group_spec dg
        ON i.dataflow_group_id = dg.dataflow_group_id
),
transformation_flows AS (
  SELECT
    t.dataflow_id AS flow_id,
    'TRANSFORMATION' AS flow_type,
    t.dataflow_group_id,
    t.flow_step_id,
    CONCAT(t.target_catalog, '.', t.target_schema, '.', t.target_table) AS source_sink_mapping,
    t.target_type,
    t.cdc_load_strategy,
    t.is_active AS flow_is_active,
    dg.environment,
    dg.catalog_name,
    dg.is_active AS group_is_active,
    dg.created_at AS group_created_at,
    dg.updated_at AS group_updated_at
  FROM
    transformation_flow_spec t
      INNER JOIN dataflow_group_spec dg
        ON t.dataflow_group_id = dg.dataflow_group_id
),
all_flows AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    ingestion_flows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    transformation_flows
)
SELECT
  af.dataflow_group_id,
  af.flow_id,
  af.flow_step_id,
  af.flow_type,
  af.source_sink_mapping,
  af.target_type,
  af.cdc_load_strategy,
  af.flow_is_active,
  af.group_is_active,
  af.environment,
  af.catalog_name,
  af.group_created_at,
  af.group_updated_at,
  a.action_type AS audit_action,
  a.onboarded_by AS inserted_by,
  a.onboarded_at AS inserted_at,
  a.status AS audit_status,
  a.spec_version
FROM
  all_flows af
    LEFT JOIN onboarding_audit_log a
      ON af.dataflow_group_id = a.dataflow_group_id
ORDER BY
  af.group_created_at DESC,
  af.flow_id,
  a.onboarded_at DESC

datasets.name: kpi_metrics_filtered
queryLines:
SELECT
  dg.dataflow_group_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN i.dataflow_id IS NOT NULL THEN i.dataflow_id
      WHEN t.flow_step_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.flow_step_id
    END
  ) AS total_flows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN dg.is_active = TRUE THEN dg.dataflow_group_id
    END
  ) AS active_groups,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN a.action_type = 'INSERT' THEN a.audit_event_id
    END
  ) AS audit_insert_actions
FROM
  dataflow_group_spec dg
    LEFT JOIN ingestion_flow_spec i
      ON dg.dataflow_group_id = i.dataflow_group_id
    LEFT JOIN transformation_flow_spec t
      ON dg.dataflow_group_id = t.dataflow_group_id
    LEFT JOIN onboarding_audit_log a
      ON dg.dataflow_group_id = a.dataflow_group_id
GROUP BY
  dg.dataflow_group_id

datasets.name: ingestion_flows_detail
queryLines:
SELECT

  dg.updated_at AS group_updated_at
FROM

ORDER BY

datasets.name: reconciliation_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.reconciliation_id,
  r.dataflow_group_id,
  r.source_config_json,
  r.target_configs_json,
  r.match_keys_json,
  r.compare_columns_json,
  r.generate_surrogate_key,
  r.transform_sql,
  r.is_active,
  dg.environment,
  dg.is_active AS group_is_active,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rl.run_id) AS total_runs,
  MAX(rl.run_at) AS last_run_at,
  SUM(rl.matched_count) AS total_matched,
  SUM(rl.missing_in_target_count) AS total_missing_in_target,
  SUM(rl.missing_in_source_count) AS total_missing_in_source,
  SUM(rl.value_drift_count) AS total_value_drift
FROM
  reconciliation_flow_spec r
    INNER JOIN dataflow_group_spec dg
      ON r.dataflow_group_id = dg.dataflow_group_id
    LEFT JOIN reconciliation_run_log rl
      ON r.reconciliation_id = rl.reconciliation_id
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  r.dataflow_group_id,
  r.reconciliation_id

datasets.name: audit_log_detail
queryLines:
SELECT

  a.dataflow_group_id,
  a.action_type,
  a.onboarded_by,
  a.onboarded_at,
  a.spec_version,

datasets.name: raw_spec_json
queryLines:
SELECT
  'ingestion' AS flow_kind,
  i.dataflow_id,
  i.dataflow_group_id,
  dg.environment,
  i.source_type,
  i.target_type,
  CONCAT(i.target_catalog, '.', i.target_schema, '.', i.target_table) AS full_target_path,
  i.is_active,
  i.source_config_json,
  i.target_config_json,
  i.dq_config_json,
  i.governance_tags_json,
  TO_JSON(
    STRUCT(
      i.dataflow_id AS dataflow_id,
      i.dataflow_group_id AS dataflow_group_id,
      i.source_type AS source_type,
      i.target_catalog AS target_catalog,
      i.target_schema AS target_schema,
      i.target_table AS target_table,
      i.target_type AS target_type,
      i.cdc_load_strategy AS cdc_load_strategy,
      i.source_config_json AS source_config_json,
      i.target_config_json AS target_config_json,
      i.dq_config_json AS dq_config_json,
      i.governance_tags_json AS governance_tags_json
    )
  ) AS full_spec_json
FROM
  ingestion_flow_spec i
    INNER JOIN dataflow_group_spec dg
      ON i.dataflow_group_id = dg.dataflow_group_id

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'transformation' AS flow_kind,
  t.dataflow_id,
  t.dataflow_group_id,
  dg.environment,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_type,
  t.target_type,
  CONCAT(t.target_catalog, '.', t.target_schema, '.', t.target_table) AS full_target_path,
  t.is_active,
  t.source_inputs_json AS source_config_json,
  t.target_config_json,
  t.dq_config_json,
  t.governance_tags_json,
  TO_JSON(
    STRUCT(
      t.dataflow_id AS dataflow_id,
      t.dataflow_group_id AS dataflow_group_id,
      t.flow_step_id AS flow_step_id,
      t.target_catalog AS target_catalog,
      t.target_schema AS target_schema,
      t.target_table AS target_table,
      t.target_type AS target_type,
      t.cdc_load_strategy AS cdc_load_strategy,
      t.source_inputs_json AS source_inputs_json,
      t.transformation_sql AS transformation_sql,
      t.target_config_json AS target_config_json,
      t.dq_config_json AS dq_config_json,
      t.governance_tags_json AS governance_tags_json
    )
  ) AS full_spec_json
FROM
  transformation_flow_spec t
    INNER JOIN dataflow_group_spec dg
      ON t.dataflow_group_id = dg.dataflow_group_id
ORDER BY
  dataflow_group_id,
  flow_kind,
  dataflow_id
